Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text

        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

arguments.title: Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard
arguments.body:
## Completed experiment scorecard

- **Traffic / allocation:** 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- **Primary outcome (routed out for an existing unsupported condition):** 38/344 control starts (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment starts (7.1%); **35.7% relative reduction**, exceeding the predeclared ≥25% reduction threshold.
- **Admission-completion guardrail:** 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment (**+0.3 percentage points**); within the maximum 1.5-point decline limit.
- **Support-time guardrail:** Account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 71 minutes control versus 74 minutes treatment (**+3 minutes**); within the maximum +10-minute limit.
- **Cohort consistency:** The favorable route-out direction held in all three complete weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort; both guardrails remained within limits.
- **Concurrent pricing-page change check:** No unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred during the test/stabilization window, supporting clean attribution.

**Readout:** The test cleared its path-quality threshold and both guardrails. This supports fewer unsupported self-serve starts; it is not evidence of revenue lift, paid-acquisition economics, pipeline impact, forecast credit, or changed Helio Start eligibility.
